subcommands.name: publish
subcommands.description: Publishes an MQTT message. Requires permission to access the Publish action.

options.name: --topic
options.description: The name of the MQTT topic

options.name: --qos
options.description: The Quality of Service (QoS) level. The default QoS level is 0

options.name: --retain
options.description: A Boolean value that determines whether to set the RETAIN flag when the message is published.

options.name: --no-retain
options.description: A Boolean value that determines whether to set the RETAIN flag when the message is published.

options.name: --payload
options.description: The message body. MQTT accepts text, binary, and empty (null) message payloads.

options.name: --user-properties
options.description: A JSON string that contains an array of JSON objects.

options.name: --payload-format-indicator
options.description: An Enum string value that indicates whether the payload is formatted as UTF-8. payloadFormatIndicator is an HTTP header value in the API

options.name: --content-type
options.description: A UTF-8 encoded string that describes the content of the publishing message

options.name: --response-topic
options.description: A UTF-8 encoded string that's used as the topic name for a response message.

options.name: --correlation-data
options.description: The base64-encoded binary data used by the sender of the request message to identify which request the response message is for when it's received.

options.name: --message-expiry
options.description: A user-defined integer value that represents the message expiry interval in seconds. If absent, the message doesn't expire.
